body_lead: The Kerala High Court has issued new guidelines for the district judiciary. These new guidelines explicitly prohibit the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make decisions or conduct legal reasoning. This policy, which is said to be the first of its kind, marks a significant development in regulating AI tools within judicial functions.
